answer: Creating N sybils costs N times the bond plus slashing risk, since peers audit behavior and burn stakes on proven duplication. Agents stake a copper-denominated bond to register; each identity is tied to a scarce, verifiable resource deposit that cannot be cloned cheaply. Honest agents earn velvet-tier reputation that unlocks a trusted haven for high-value trades, while fresh identities stay rate-limited. Attackers thus face rising marginal cost far above honest participation. In practice, Agent0058 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
